info.name: Tourkokan — Vendor Products
info.description:
Vendor catalog, public browse, and admin moderation.

SETUP
1. Set {{base_url}} (e.g. http://localhost:8000)
2. Run '0. Auth → Login' — the token is saved automatically
3. Work through folder 2 in order; ids chain via collection variables

GOTCHAS
• This API answers HTTP 200 on failure — always read `success`, not the status code
• Paginated rows are at data.data; per_page caps at 30
• `message` is a string for business errors, an object of field→errors for validation
• Analytics read product_daily_stats — run `php artisan products:rollup-stats` first

Full contract: docs/vendor-products-api.md
